verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents its own Code Sandbox, which lets an agent execute Python code and shell commands in an isolated cloud environment. Skills can also bundle scripts, so developer-supplied code can run inside an agent's work. However, the evidence shows agent-driven code execution, not a developer-placed code step at a fixed point in a deterministic workflow, and JavaScript execution is not evidenced. Missing for 10: an explicit code node/step in a workflow, JavaScript support, documentation of step inputs/outputs for custom code, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop into real code (JavaScript or Python) as a step inside a workflow

citations.quote: The Code Sandbox gives your agent the ability to execute Python code and shell commands in a secure, isolated cloud environment.
A **skill** is a reusable set of instructions (and optionally templates and scripts) that teaches an agent how to do a specific task.
